create_styler_apply: create a styled DataFrame by applying a CSS-styling function column-wise with Styler.apply
create_styler_map: create a styled DataFrame by applying a CSS-styling function elementwise with Styler.map
build_styler_highlight: build a styled DataFrame that highlights null, max, min values, ranges, and quantiles with conditional formatting
build_styler_export_use: build a reusable Styler by exporting styles and applying them to a different DataFrame with Styler.export and Styler.use
create_styler_output: create styled HTML, LaTeX, Typst, Excel, or string output from a DataFrame Styler with to_html, to_latex, to_excel, to_string, to_typst
